scope: All files in this release directory, including hidden files, source snapshots, data and embedded ZIP contents if present. No Git directory/history is present.
limitations: Pattern-based scan and curated-file review, not a guarantee that arbitrary unknown credentials cannot be present. Public PDB depositor/citation metadata and upstream copyright contacts are preserved.
finder_note: Finder may recreate .DS_Store while browsing; these files are removed when found and always excluded from the release archive and checksums.
